app.title: HIS Simulator
app.subtitle: A simulated hospital information system for CareLoop

banner.simulated: Simulated data only. Every patient, staff member and message shown here is synthetic.

placeholder.notice: This screen is a placeholder. It has not been built yet.

scenarioRunner.title: Scenario runner
scenarioRunner.description: Replays the HIS steps of a scripted, simulated scenario against CareLoop.

planned.list: List the scenarios found in the scenarios directory
planned.run: Start a run of a chosen scenario
planned.progress: Show the progress and result of each step in a run
planned.expect: Show what the scenario is expected to demonstrate

staffInbox.title: Staff inbox
staffInbox.description: Simulated messages CareLoop has sent to hospital staff. Receiving a message is not an acknowledgement.

planned.list: List escalations, handoff proposals, call requests, handoff summaries and staff notifications
planned.filter: Filter the inbox by the member of staff it is addressed to
planned.detail: Open an item to see its FHIR message

fhirLog.title: FHIR message log
fhirLog.description: Every simulated FHIR message this simulator has sent to CareLoop or received from it.

planned.sent: List the messages sent to CareLoop with their HTTP status
planned.received: List the messages received from CareLoop
planned.filter: Filter by direction and by case
planned.body: Show the FHIR JSON of a message

clinicianActions.title: Act as clinician
clinicianActions.description: Manually perform the actions a person would take in the hospital system. The simulator never decides urgency or closure itself.

planned.cases: Choose one of the simulated cases
planned.review: Record a clinical review with the reviewed urgency
planned.closure: Authorize closure with evidence or a documented exception
